messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do this before first dose"
set: ["do this before first dose", "do this before starting", "before first use", "caregiver should be trained before first dose", "first dose administered 30 minutes before the start of chemotherapy", "first dose usually taken before surgery, chemotherapy, or radiation treatment", "first oral dose given 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy", "first dose given 30 minutes before the start of emetogenic chemotherapy", "first parenteral dose given 30 minutes before start of emetogenic chemotherapy", "first dose given upon awakening", "starting dose for first 14 days", "first dose infused over 15 minutes", "two weeks before conception and through first trimester", "do not breast-feed while taking this medicine", "within about 1 hour of first dose", "first dose of the day is usually taken when first wake up"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
